script:
Presenter: Why was this project started?
Amina: We wanted to make weekly school news bulletin because our school community needed a practical improvement.
Presenter: Where did you plan the first version?
Amina: We began in the media room, where our teacher organised responsibilities for everyone.
Presenter: When was the team meeting held?
Amina: It was Monday afternoon, which allowed our team to prepare without missing lessons.
Presenter: Which item was particularly useful?
Amina: We used a microphone, and checked that it was suitable for the task.
Presenter: Who checked the details and safety?
Amina: We consulted two teachers instead of trusting rumours or making unsupported claims.
Presenter: Did students work completely alone?
Amina: No, our teacher supervised carefully, while students researched information and shared different responsibilities.
Presenter: What problem appeared during the project?
Amina: Our first attempt contained an incorrect activity date, so the results needed further checking.
Presenter: How did your group correct the error?
Amina: We returned to the official school notice and explained our correction clearly to teammates.
Presenter: Who will benefit from your work?
Amina: We hope younger pupils will gain useful information from the finished project.
Presenter: What did users suggest improving?
Amina: They recommended slower speech and captions, and we recorded their suggestions for the next version.
Presenter: How did you handle disagreements?
Amina: We listened respectfully, considered the evidence and tested the strongest suggestions together.
Presenter: What did the team do with feedback?
Amina: We discussed comments at our weekly meeting and made a clear improvement plan.
Presenter: What will you prepare next term?
Amina: Our next step will be shorter interviews, building on the experience gained this term.
Presenter: What is the most important lesson?
Amina: We learned the value of clear communication, honest feedback and careful preparation. Every group member also checked the final explanation and asked useful questions before sharing it with others.
